description: Configuration file for an Angular application; sets up providers for routing, HTTP client, hydration, environment, and title strategy.

classes.name: AppTitleStrategy
classes.description: Custom TitleStrategy implementation for managing document titles based on route data.

methods.name: provideZoneChangeDetection
methods.description: Provides zone change detection with event coalescing for performance optimization.

methods.name: provideRouter
methods.description: Sets up the application's routing with specified routes.

methods.name: provideClientHydration
methods.description: Enables hydration support, especially relevant for server-side rendering and event replay.

methods.name: provideHttpClient
methods.description: Provides the HTTP client service for making HTTP requests.

methods.name: provideEnvironment
methods.description: Injects environment configuration tokens, differentiating between browser and SSR environments.
